title: Dify, which offers an open-source platform to build and run AI applications and agentic workflows, raised a $30M pre-Series A led by HSG at a $180M valuation (FinSMEs)
summary: FinSMEs: Dify, which offers an open-source platform to build and run AI applications and agentic workflows, raised a $30M pre-Series A led by HSG at a $180M valuation — Dify, a Menlo Park, CA-based provider of an open-source platform that helps teams build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI applications …
